purpose: Teach: 八つ/裁き/如実/無敵/メリハリ/如き/へそ/爺さん

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが八つの子を抱えて働かれた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he worked while raising eight children.
lines.style: Distant, reminiscing. Soft opening. Gentle pace, each memory surfacing slowly. Voice carries quiet admiration. Trails off slightly at the end as if still looking back.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、村の裁きを公平にされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — your grandfather kept the village judgements fair, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, affirming. Leans into the shared memory. Slight uplift on 'fair' — gentle pride. Tender closing with 'dear', intimate and knowing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんの強さが如実に分かった
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, you could see his strength so clearly.
lines.style: Quieter this time. Searching for the right word. Gentle awe underneath. Slow, deliberate pace. Voice softens on 'strength' — not bragging, just truthful.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、戦場では無敵の働きをされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather was unbeatable on the battlefield, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Pride threaded through warmth. Not boastful — matter-of-fact admiration. Slight emphasis on 'unbeatable'. Closes with intimate 'dear', affirming what they both know.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは仕事と家庭のメリハリを保たれた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he knew how to balance work and home.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to himself. Moderate pace. Voice carries quiet respect for this kind of discipline. Gentle exhale after 'balance' — the weight of knowing this matters.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、賢者の如き判断をされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather made wise choices like a sage, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Affectionate agreement. Light emphasis on 'wise'. Warm, conversational tone — not flowery, just clear-eyed recognition. Closes tenderly with 'dear'.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんのへそが見える格好で寝てらした
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he'd sleep with his belly showing.
lines.style: Gentle shift to something smaller, more human. Slight warmth now — almost affectionate amusement. Slower pace. The detail lingers, like a small and precious image.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、爺さんと孫に呼ばれて喜んでらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather was so happy to be called Grandpa, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Soft, close warmth. Voice almost in your ear — intimate recollection. Gentle smile in the tone. Lingering on 'happy' — the simple joy of being needed. Closes with quiet tenderness.
